name: Place a hold on a share
description: Places a restrictive hold on one of a member's shares. Requires a supervisor session; a teller invocation is refused before the run touches the host.

inputParams.name: shareCode
inputParams.description: Share suffix to place the hold on.

inputParams.name: reasonCode
inputParams.description: Reason code: FRAUD, LEGAL or DECEASED.

inputParams.name: notes
inputParams.description: Free-text note recorded against the hold.

outputs.name: confirmationNumber
outputs.description: Extract confirmation number from success screen

outputs.name: heldShareId
outputs.description: Extract held share identifier from success screen
